verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th suhelaRaa manmukh baareh vaaT fira(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The Guru-oriented move upon the simple and straight way and the mind-oriented (manmukh) go astray on twelve ways (the twelve sects of the Yogis).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਦਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਵਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਡੁਬੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh paar la(n)ghaidhaa manmukh bhavajal vich dduba(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs get across whereas the manmukhs get drowned in the world-ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh jeevan mukat kar manmukh fir fir janam mara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The life of gurmukh is the sacred tank of liberation and the manmukhs go on transmigrating and suffering the pangs of life and death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal paidhe manmukh dhukh fal dhukh laha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The gurmukh is at ease in the court of the Lord but the manmukh  has to bear (pain of) the rod of yama, the god of death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਰਖ ਰੂ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh dharageh surakh roo manmukh jam pur dda(n)dd saha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The gurmukh is at ease in the court of the Lord but the manmukh has to bear (pain of) the rod of yama, the god of death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh aap gavaiaa manmukh haumai agan jala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The gurmukh forsakes ego whereas manmukh burns himself continuously in the fire of  egotism.
Rare are the people who though being in the limits (of maya) yet remain immersed in His meditation.
